company.description: HireSweet allows Tech companies to recruit the best developers and regain control of their hiring process. HireSweet scans GitHub, Stack Overflow and other technical platforms to find the experts and potential engineers for their clients. HireSweet processes unstructured data, such as profile descriptions and categorizes developers depending on skills, projects, adaptability and more.
